beginner_statement: The system usually refuses to act, and when it acts it only chooses the positive direction. It can often recognize risky candidates, but the saved evidence is not rich enough to tell whether the main cause is the scores, the action rule, or the risk veto.
confidence: high for the functional failure and abstention-dominant behavior; medium for the upstream mechanism
limitations: no per-action mean/q05 utility score vector
no region or semantic subgroup rows
no composite confidence for independent risk-coverage replay
post-hoc diagnostics do not alter the terminal decision

mechanism_hypotheses.hypothesis: inference representation lacks material action-conditioned signed relative utility
mechanism_hypotheses.missing: per-action utility scores or an independent contract

mechanism_hypotheses.hypothesis: coverage/readout conflict causes positive-only high abstention
mechanism_hypotheses.missing: frozen composite score vector and preregistered component replay

mechanism_hypotheses.hypothesis: risk head predicts generic difficulty rather than action-specific harm
mechanism_hypotheses.missing: predeclared generic-vs-action-specific matched control; post-hoc cell and concordance metrics are descriptive

mechanism_hypotheses.hypothesis: image/group aggregation hides local gain-harm cancellation
mechanism_hypotheses.missing: region-level utilities and fixed region labels

mechanism_hypotheses.hypothesis: labels are unstable to implementation or perturbation
mechanism_hypotheses.missing: segmentation, sensor, precision and real-domain perturbations

scope: R4B-A1 folds 0/1, 384 development images, D_ref/D_rep, no-op/positive-full/negative-full, ensemble seeds 3407/3411
updated_formal_statement: Within the frozen Haze4K development folds, three-action bank and R4B-A1 inference-visible representation, the deployable decision contract fails to convert candidate-conditioned signals into material signed utility and safe coverage. Raw policy rows show that the realized retention loss is dominated by abstention and the rare active policy remains positive-only; raw candidate-risk rows retain real risk discrimination, but the persisted artifacts cannot identify whether the upstream cause is utility representation, readout/coverage calibration, action-conditioned veto, or their interaction.
